يتميّز برنامج eSchool بأنّه أنشئ بناءً على أفكار معلّمين وإداريّين ورؤساء مدارس ما جعله برنامجًا عمليًّا ناجحًا وسهل الاستخدام من قبل الأهل والتلاميذ والمعلّمين، ويتماشى مع كلّ الأوضاع والتغيّرات، كما يتميّز هذا البرنامج بأنّه يغطّي معظم حاجات العمل الإداريّ من خلال (eSchool administration) بالإضافة إلى خدمات التّعليم عن بعد وإثبات نجاحه في هذا المجال، مع الإشارة إلى وجود فريق دعم متعاون رغم الضغط الشديد عليه. Written by: Hussein Abdel Sater, Vice president | Chief Information Officer

eSchool Room: Productive Meetings: eSchool Rooms offers a dynamic learning environment with whiteboard writing, video, and voice communication for real-time interaction. Features like commenting, media sharing, quizzes, and polls enhance engagement and comprehension, while recording sessions ensure accessibility. Interactive chat fosters communication and community among students and instructors, creating an immersive and effective online learning experience.

ان الجمعية الحميدية الخيرية الإسلامية وبعد استخدامها لبرنامج eSchool وتطبيقاته المختلفة ساعدت على توثيق التواصل مع الأهل لمتابعة التلميذ تربوياً، خاصة في فترة التعليم عن بعد. إضافة إلى ذلك ساهم برنامج eSchool في تسهيل وتنظيم العمل الإداري والمالي في مدارس الجمعية بكافة فروعها. نشكر إدارة شركة eSchool والعاملين فيها على تقديم الخدمات والتحديثات المتعددة والمتواصلة وعلى جهوزيتهم الدائمة في الرد على كافة الاستفسارات والتساؤلات، متمنين لكم المزيد من التطور والنجاح. Written by: Lawyer Khaled Mohammed Al-Zoubi, president

eSchool Content: Navigation Tools: The Navigation Tools feature simplifies access to information and resources with intuitive menus, search options, and clear categorization. It includes a "Go to Page" feature, enabling users to quickly navigate to specific sections or pages within the app. Additionally, thumbnails provide visual cues, further enhancing navigation efficiency by allowing users to preview content before accessing it. This ensures efficient navigation, saving time and enhancing usability for students, faculty, and staff.

The eSchool program implemented at our school, The National Evangelical School in Nabatieh, provides a comprehensive set of services designed to address various administrative and academic processes. It offers an efficient grading system that guarantees accuracy and transparency in recording and managing student grades. The system also manages financial files flawlessly, enabling the school to maintain organized records of fees and transactions. Moreover, eSchool supports the definition and management of courses, allowing for clear structuring and customization to meet academic needs. The program's team is highly cooperative, addressing all concerns with professionalism and promptness, ensuring that users encounter minimal interruption and maximum assistance. Written by: Shadi El Hajjar, School Principal

eSchool Content: Download Books with an Offline Preview: It offers book downloading feature, allowing users to download textbooks and resources for offline access. This ensures learning continuity even without an internet connection, promoting flexibility and accessibility for students and faculty. Additionally, it supports sustainability by reducing the need for printed materials.

Our Journey - 2019: Our Significant Milestone. During the COVID-19 pandemic, our live classes feature achieved significant milestones by creating an educational online platform that provided students with uninterrupted learning opportunities. The platform was highly secure and efficient, allowing teachers and administrators to maintain control over the educational process seamlessly. It boasted a vast library of over 1 million digital educational videos, offering diverse and comprehensive resources for all subjects. Despite the challenges posed by online teaching, our students achieved excellent results, effectively bridging the educational gap created by the pandemic.
